secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign/verify JWT session tokens. The app generates a dev fallback if unset, but set a real value for persistent sessions.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://xyz.supabase.co). Optional — the app uses an in-memory store when unset.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase public anon key. Optional — only needed for Supabase persistence.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key used by the backend for privileged operations. Optional — only needed for Supabase persistence.

secrets.name: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
secrets.description: Firebase service account JSON (string or Base64). Optional — only needed for Firebase persistence/auth.

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID
secrets.description: Firebase project ID. Optional — only needed for Firebase client integration.

secrets.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Firebase public API key. Optional — only needed for Firebase client integration.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase URL exposed to the frontend bundle. Optional.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon key exposed to the frontend bundle. Optional.
